status: prospective acquisition amendment before full training or decisive matches
stop_rule: Stop new pairs when the committed preparation index reaches the target, at least 100000 completed games and nonempty validation/test splits. Drain at most eight in-flight pairs. Require preparation to consume every committed pair and confirm at least 10000000 actual distinct training inputs before declaring acquisition complete. If later collisions invalidate the minimum, acquisition is incomplete.
resume_rule: Keep the same corpus CONFIG, executable, seed, search policy, node budget and maximum pair request. Preserve the original session wall origin and sum actual child CPU over every gracefully completed session. Refuse strict CPU-budget resumption after missing session accounting.
independence: Preparation counts are operational stop signals, not final evidence. A separate verifier reconstructs every original game, split, feature, target and lineage and enforces the hard floors again.
retention: Retain every completed pair, both colors, all outcomes, prior protocol and session journals. Do not delete earlier pairs or reset cumulative budgets.
strength_rule: This data acquisition amendment changes no strength sample or neural-gain threshold. All decisive strength matches remain fixed sample, separately frozen before execution.
